scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-limit proof with finite reproducibility checks; literature priority qualified by possible equivalent general beta-binomial Renyi-asymptotic theorem; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Ideal lossless balanced two-mode splitter, two equal-number Fock inputs, fixed positive Renyi order; excludes noise, unequal inputs and moving-order scaling. Prior exact probabilities and beta-binomial law are not claimed as new.
title: Critical Rényi-index transition in balanced twin-Fock entanglement
